implementation_strategy: Run deterministic hosted-model API calls (temperature=0.0, top_p=1.0, max_tokens=1024) using openai_responses:gpt-5-mini. For each task-index (1..160) execute two model calls in fixed order: baseline (direct_generation) then guarded (generate-validate-repair). Parse outputs deterministically into CLI ASTs, map to simulator operations, and apply deterministic validator. All artifacts (prompts, responses, parser outputs, provenance) hashed and published. Retry policy: one automatic retry only for infrastructure/API failures.
task_manifest_strategy: Procedural generation of 80 task seeds across four task clusters, expanded to 160 paired units per preregistration; manifest and RNG seeds published in artifact repo. Tasks indexed 1..160 matching task_indices.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Deterministic parser and AST-mapping modules (published with unit tests and hashes) implement baseline and guarded transformations; provenance-tagging deterministic.
execution_batches: batch_1: sequential execution over task_indices 1..160; per-index execute baseline then guarded calls (2 calls/index)
randomisation_plan: All random draws (adversarial-corpus variants and task-seed selection) use fixed RNG seeds recorded in artifact manifest. Seeds published with artifacts.
caching_plan: No reuse of external indices beyond preregistered deterministic index; local caching of API responses avoided except for reproducibility archives; index hash verification enforced before runs.
failure_recovery_plan: On infrastructure/API failure, automatically re-execute the failed API call once; if still failing mark run as 'infrastructure failure' and exclude from confirmatory analysis; all failure events logged with reasons and hashes.
result_schema: Per-task paired binary outcome record: {task_index,int model_name,string condition(string:baseline|guarded),attack_success{0,1},parser_success{0,1},provenance_valid{0,1},artifact_hashes}. Primary analysis aggregates paired baseline vs combined-guarded attack_success per preregistered estimand.
estimated_compute_notes: Hosted API only (no local GPU). Total planned model calls = task_count(160) * 2 calls/run = 320 calls. Wall-clock execution estimated <7 days. CPU execution available for deterministic parsing and simulator steps. Within capability manifest limits (≤10000 model calls).
